name: openai-responses-starter-app
setup: . scripts/env.sh && cd "$SRC" && { test -f next-env.d.ts || printf '/// <reference types="next" />\n/// <reference types="next/image-types/global" />\n' > next-env.d.ts; }
notes: Env: commands assume $RM (router-migrate root) and $SRC (working copy) are exported and scripts/env.sh is sourced (setup does this itself); run every step under `env -u RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY`. Node v24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, local pnpm 10.34.7, yarn berry from the repo. Setup writes the standard gitignored next-env.d.ts (`next dev`/`next build` would create it). Without it, tsc reports spurious missing-declaration errors for .png/.css imports. No tests exist (no test script/framework/CI), so test_cmd is a TypeScript typecheck (strict tsconfig, TS 5.8.2, 53 project files, --incremental false so no tsbuildinfo is written). Baseline: 0 errors, which settles the inventory's open question: the loosely typed tools array against openai 4.89.0 does typecheck. passed/failed/skipped are null because tsc has no test counts. `errors` = count of `error TS` lines. `npm run lint` (next lint) and `npm run build` were not used (build needs no key but is slow; lint is deprecated in Next 15). npm ERESOLVE peer warnings (@reach/* wants react<=17) are harmless. Cold-cache install took 39s. 2 runs: identical (0 errors).
